key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Position in the top panel
key.description: Which panel box the indicator is placed in.

key.name: show-previous
key.summary: Show the previous button in the panel

key.name: show-play-pause
key.summary: Show the play/pause button in the panel

key.name: show-next
key.summary: Show the next button in the panel

key.name: show-seek-backward
key.summary: Show the skip-backward button in the panel
key.description: Only shown for players that support seeking. Skips by seek-step-seconds.

key.name: show-seek-forward
key.summary: Show the skip-forward button in the panel
key.description: Only shown for players that support seeking. Skips by seek-step-seconds.

key.name: show-shuffle
key.summary: Show the shuffle button in the panel
key.description: Only shown for players that support shuffle.

key.name: show-loop
key.summary: Show the loop button in the panel
key.description: Only shown for players that support looping. Cycles between off, the whole queue, and one track.

key.name: show-player-icon
key.summary: Show the player's application icon in the panel

key.name: show-title
key.summary: Show the track title in the panel

key.name: show-artist
key.summary: Show the artist in the panel

key.name: panel-text-width
key.summary: Maximum width of the panel text, in pixels
key.description: The track text is never wider than this. Text that does not fit is truncated with an ellipsis, or scrolled when scroll-text is set.

key.name: panel-text-min-width
key.summary: Minimum width of the panel text, in pixels
key.description: The track text takes its own width, but never less than this and never more than panel-text-width. At or above panel-text-width, the text always occupies panel-text-width.

key.name: scroll-text
key.summary: Scroll panel text that does not fit
key.description: Text wider than panel-text-width scrolls past it once for each new track, then rests truncated with an ellipsis.

key.name: scroll-speed
key.summary: Scrolling speed in pixels per second

key.name: scroll-direction
key.summary: Which way the scrolling text travels

key.name: controls-on-left
key.summary: Place the playback controls before the text

key.name: hide-when-inactive
key.summary: Hide the indicator when no player is running

key.name: card-show-art
key.summary: Show album art in the card

key.name: card-art-size
key.summary: How large the album art is drawn in the card
key.description: Only has an effect while card-show-art is set. The fallback player icon scales to match.

key.name: card-art-backdrop
key.summary: Fill the card with a frosted backdrop made from the album art
key.description: The artwork is blurred into fields of color behind the card's text and controls, and darkened beneath them. The card stays dark glass in both the light and the dark style. Tracks without artwork keep the plain card. Works whether or not card-show-art is set.

key.name: pause-others-on-play
key.summary: Only let one player play at a time
key.description: When a player starts playing, whichever other player was playing is paused. Players already running when the extension starts are left alone.

key.name: card-show-player-switcher
key.summary: Show the player switcher in the card
key.description: A button beside the volume bar naming the player on screen. While more than one player is running, it opens a list of them all, with what each is playing, to switch between.

key.name: card-show-seek-bar
key.summary: Show the seek bar in the card

key.name: card-show-seek-buttons
key.summary: Show the skip-back and skip-forward buttons in the card

key.name: card-show-shuffle
key.summary: Show the shuffle button in the card
key.description: Only shown for players that support shuffle.

key.name: card-show-loop
key.summary: Show the loop button in the card
key.description: Only shown for players that support looping. Cycles between off, the whole queue, and one track.

key.name: card-show-volume
key.summary: Show the volume bar in the card
key.description: A slider under the playback controls that sets the player's own volume. Only shown for players that let their volume be set over MPRIS, which browsers do not.

key.name: card-show-output-switcher
key.summary: Show the sound output button in the card
key.description: A button at the bottom right of the card showing the sound output in use, such as speakers or headphones. While more than one output is available, it opens a list of them to switch between. The choice is the system's default output, the same as in the sound menu, so it applies to every app rather than only the player on screen.

key.name: card-show-lyrics-button
key.summary: Show the lyrics button in the card
key.description: A button beside the card's settings button that shows the lyrics of the current song, following along line by line when they are timed. Only shown for music players, and for local audio files in players that also play video.

key.name: lyrics-online-lookup
key.summary: Look up lyrics on LRCLIB
key.description: When neither the player nor an .lrc file beside the track has lyrics, ask lrclib.net. The track's title, artist, album and length are sent, and only while the lyrics are open.

key.name: lyrics-height
key.summary: Height of the lyrics in the card, in pixels
key.description: How much of the card the lyrics take while they are open. On a screen without room for that much, the lyrics are made shorter so the card still fits.

key.name: seek-step-seconds
key.summary: Seconds skipped by the seek buttons

key.name: card-width
key.summary: Card width in pixels

key.name: last-announced-version
key.summary: Release the update notification last announced
key.description: Internal. Keeps the what's-new notification to once per release.
